item.title: Agents Can't Be Your Community: The Economics of Fake Growth
item.description: AI agents can't replace community engagement, developer relations, or ecosystem building. Automation without real customers is just wash trading — activity that burns capital without generating external demand.

item.title: The Loyalty Deficit: Is Developer Community a Retention Moat in the AI Race?
item.description: A testable case that developer community is a retention moat in the AI race - what lift it needs per percent of ARR spent, a CFO-ready scorecard, and a decision gate with a stop rule.
